name: sociahive
description: Schedule and publish posts to 22 networks (Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, Bluesky, Pinterest, Telegram, Discord, Slack and more), build DM and comment automations, and read analytics, through the hosted SociaHive MCP server.

interface.longDescription: SociaHive lets you plan, schedule and publish posts to 22 networks (Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, Bluesky, Pinterest, Telegram, Discord, Slack and more) from a conversation. Describe an automation in plain words (for example, DM a price list to everyone who comments PRICE) and SociaHive builds it as a draft for you to review and turn on. You can also read post and automation analytics. Publishing now asks for your confirmation, and automations are created as drafts that the agent checks with you before turning on. Requires a SociaHive account on the 7-day trial or a paid plan.
defaultPrompt: Schedule this caption to Instagram and LinkedIn for tomorrow at 9am.
When someone comments PRICE on my latest reel, DM them my price list.
How did my posts do last week?
